why: Han, Liu, and Zhuang (arXiv:2509.01501, Sep 2025) prove effective termination of general type MMPs (hence no infinite sequence of flips) in dimensions 4 and 5, stating that termination of fourfold general type MMPs was not previously known; this settles a case (general type, dims 4-5) of the stated termination-of-flips question, leaving the general case in dimension >5 and non-general-type cases open.
